newsitem.title: USA: Unocal Los Angeles refinery unit restored.
newsitem.headline: Unocal Los Angeles refinery unit restored.

text.p: A hydrocracker at Unocal Corp's Wilmington refinery in the Los Angeles area has been restored after coming off line earlier in the week due to a power outage, a source familiar with the refinery said.
"I believe it's back up now," the source said, noting the unit went out of service on Monday after the power outage occurred late Sunday evening.

"It was off balance, then it went down," the source said, referring to the unit, which has 25,000 barrel per day (bpd) processing capacity. A Unocal official declined to comment on operations at the refinery, which runs 119,000 bpd of crude.
((-- Oliver Ludwig, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1633))
